Reaction-DSL API details¶

The primary workflow and examples are documented in Core API.

Use chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl.compile_file or compile_dict to validate chemistry before coordinate generation. Use initialize_file, choose_candidates and react only when you need to test or integrate engine-independent reaction-state logic.

.. py:function:: compile_file(path) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: compile_dict(raw) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: initialize_file(path, rng) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: choose_candidates(state, n=300, rng=None) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: react(candidates, weights, state, reaction_path, top_k=30, pass_rate=0.5, rng=None) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

The detailed input language is described in Reaction-DSL.
